PlayerSave.title: PlayerSave
PlayerSave.description: Cloud save progress for a night guard in TELECHOBIS LAND, tracking unlocked nights (1 to 7), deaths, and Night 7 Extras/Night-Selector unlock state (preserving v1 Night 6 unlocks).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

displayName.description: Guard callsign or player display name.

currentNight.description: Active night number (1 to 7) for Continue Game.

completedNights.description: Highest number of nights completed (0 to 7).

night6Completed.description: Whether the player has survived Night 6 or higher.

night7Completed.description: Whether the player has survived Night 7 (Final Boss Night).

extrasUnlocked.description: Whether Extras and Night Selector are unlocked (earned via Night 7 or preserved from earlier v1 Night 6 completion).

bestNightPowerRemaining.description: Highest remaining battery percentage achieved at 6:00 AM.

/saves/{userId}.description: Per-player cloud save document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
